description: Typefaces free for commercial use — for thumbnails, branding, subtitles and print.
description_zh: 可免费商用的字体——用于封面图、品牌、字幕与印刷。

entries.name: Google Fonts
entries.description: 1,700+ families, almost all under open licenses.
entries.description_zh: 1,700+ 字体家族，几乎全部采用开放许可。

entries.name: Fontshare
entries.description: Professional-quality free fonts from the Indian Type Foundry.
entries.description_zh: Indian Type Foundry 出品的专业级免费字体。

entries.name: Bunny Fonts
entries.description: Privacy-friendly, all-OFL drop-in replacement for Google Fonts.
entries.description_zh: 隐私友好、全 OFL 许可，可直接替换 Google Fonts。

entries.name: Font Squirrel
entries.description: Hand-vetted fonts that are 100% free for commercial use.
entries.description_zh: 人工审核、100% 可免费商用的字体。

entries.name: The League of Moveable Type
entries.description_zh: 最早的开源字体铸造厂。

entries.name: Velvetyne
entries.description: Experimental and quirky free open-source typefaces.
entries.description_zh: 实验性、风格独特的免费开源字体。

entries.name: Font Library
entries.description_zh: 社区维护的自由字体目录。

entries.name: DaFont
entries.description: Huge catalog; many fonts are demo or personal-use only.
entries.description_zh: 超大字体目录；许多字体仅限演示或个人使用。
entries.notes: Always check the per-font license file before commercial use.
entries.notes_zh: 商用前务必逐字核对许可文件。

entries.name: free-font (CJK)
entries.description: Curated Chinese and English fonts free for commercial use.
entries.description_zh: 中英文可商用免费字体精选。
entries.notes: Chinese-language list; mostly OFL, but a few fonts are personal-use-only, CC BY-NC or need authorization — check each font's license tag.
entries.notes_zh: 绝大多数为 OFL 等开源许可，但少数字体标记为「个人免费」「个人非商业」「CC BY-NC」或「需要授权」——商用前请逐个核对许可标签。

entries.name: Use & Modify
entries.description: Curated catalog of free fonts by a Swiss designer, with filters.
entries.description_zh: 瑞士设计师精选的可商用免费字体目录，支持筛选。

entries.name: Open Foundry
entries.description: Platform for open-licensed typefaces with showcase projects.
entries.description_zh: 开放许可字体平台，附展示项目。
entries.notes: Site FAQ: commercial use depends on each font's own licence and some have restrictions — read it before client work.
entries.notes_zh: 官网 FAQ：能否商用取决于每个字体自身的许可，部分许可存在限制——用于客户项目前请先阅读该字体许可。
